open_points.subject: FlowEdge guard propagation and NodeExecution status
open_points.question: Does “skipped node” mean only a source recorded `skipped_by_guard`, or also one recorded `upstream_failed`; and in the latter case is the dependent node `skipped_by_guard` or `upstream_failed`?
options: Both kinds of unexecuted source trigger `skipped_by_guard`
Both kinds prevent execution, but the dependent status is selected from the source statuses
open_points.default_guess: Only `skipped_by_guard` sources trigger `skipped_by_guard`; failure-caused non-execution remains `upstream_failed`.

open_points.subject: FlowEdge skip rule versus FlowConstant delivery
open_points.text: “A node one of whose input ports has every incoming edge disabled by its guard, or coming from a skipped node, is not executed” versus M16 “A typed literal pinned in a flow version and delivered to one input port like any other value”
open_points.question: When an input port also receives a FlowConstant, does that constant satisfy the port and prevent `skipped_by_guard`, or is skipping determined solely from incoming FlowEdges?
options: Any delivered constant satisfies the port, so the edge-based skip condition applies only when the port has no constant delivery
Skipping is determined solely from incoming edges, even if a constant targets the port
The proof forbids a constant and any edge from targeting the same input port
open_points.default_guess: Treat the constant as a delivery that satisfies the port, and apply `skipped_by_guard` only when the port receives neither an enabled edge value nor a constant.
